# Tray: the velvet board, 7 x 7 cells of 0.5 m (textures/velvet.png: a checker of two velvet
# steps), top at world y 0; a wood frame 0.2 m wide rising to y 0.07, brass caps on its corners.
# Generated by make_env.py. Up Z, front -Y.
new
material new Velvet --base-color 1 1 1 --no-slot
material texture Velvet base-color textures/velvet.png
material new Frame --base-color 0.4392 0.3020 0.1686 --no-slot
material new Brass --base-color 0.7137 0.5137 0.2980 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name Velvet --size 1 --location 0 0 -0.1
scale 3.500 3.500 0.2
apply --scale
material assign Velvet
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < 0.9"
delete only-faces
select all
uv project-from-view top --scale-to-bounds
mode object
add mesh cube --name BarN --size 1 --location 0.000 1.850 0.015
scale 3.900 0.200 0.110
apply --scale
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
add mesh cube --name BarS --size 1 --location 0.000 -1.850 0.015
scale 3.900 0.200 0.110
apply --scale
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
add mesh cube --name BarW --size 1 --location -1.850 0.000 0.015
scale 0.200 3.500 0.110
apply --scale
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
add mesh cube --name BarE --size 1 --location 1.850 0.000 0.015
scale 0.200 3.500 0.110
apply --scale
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
select BarN BarS BarW BarE
material assign Frame
add mesh cube --name Corner0 --size 1 --location -1.850 -1.850 0.090
scale 0.240 0.240 0.06
apply --scale
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
add mesh cube --name Corner1 --size 1 --location 1.850 -1.850 0.090
scale 0.240 0.240 0.06
apply --scale
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
add mesh cube --name Corner2 --size 1 --location -1.850 1.850 0.090
scale 0.240 0.240 0.06
apply --scale
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
add mesh cube --name Corner3 --size 1 --location 1.850 1.850 0.090
scale 0.240 0.240 0.06
apply --scale
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
select Corner0 Corner1 Corner2 Corner3
material assign Brass
select BarN BarS BarW BarE Corner0 Corner1 Corner2 Corner3
active BarN
join
rename BarN Frame
select Velvet
shade flat
select Frame
shade flat
export tray.glb
